The shipped palette could only report the freedom it had symbols for, which is why entries like this one used to read as rigid. Each slider's range is walked with the others held at the anchor and certified at its endpoint by a covering count and by the tiling's canonical map; combinations of sliders are certified in the browser, on the cell being drawn.
